data.body:
[P2] Fence subsequent plugin hooks after invocation expiry

If invocation A expires while awaiting `onOperationStart`, invocation B can start its first step before A’s hook settles. Releasing A then dispatches `onOperationAttemptStart` before reaching the guarded step callback. Both built-in OTel plugins write that attempt into B’s current state; matching operation IDs and attempt numbers overwrite B’s live span, causing missing or misattributed telemetry. The new invocation-end generation checks do not cover this path. Guard subsequent hook dispatch with its owning invocation lifecycle, and add a sequential two-invocation regression that releases A’s held start hook while B’s step is active.
